senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דפף , s. v. דַּף) to knock; (of grain) to blast. Pesik. ʿAsser, p. 99ᵇ [read:] רוח אחת … והיא שׁוֹדְפַתָּן I send one east wind, and it blasts them; Yalk. Deut. 892 שדפתן (corr. acc.); Tanḥ. R’eh 17 ומְשַׁדַּפְתָּן; Pesik. R. s. 25 ושׁוֹדֶפֶת.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:6">B. Mets. IX, 6</cite> <he>המקבל … או נִשְׁדְּפָה</he> if one tenanted a field …, and the locust ate it up, or it was blasted.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 105b:15">Ib. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>כגון שנִשְׁתַּדְּפוּ ארבע וכ׳</he> (it is considered a regional calamity,) if for instance four fields on four sides of that in litigation have been struck with blast.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 105b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ תלם אחד וכ׳</he> if one furrow over the whole length of it was struck. Y. M. Kat. III, 81ᵈ top <he>כל מקום … היה נִשְׁדָּף</he> every spot on which his eye looked was blasted; a. fr.
